# Dear ImGui snapshot

Upstream: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui (docking branch).
Version advertised by the supplied header: 1.91.5 WIP.
Imported from the user's existing local `imgui-docking` source checkout.
The upstream commit was not verified. This is a frozen source snapshot, not a claim
to use the latest release. `source-hashes.json` records SHA-256 of each imported file.
All upstream source files are unmodified. MIT license is preserved in LICENSE.txt.
Only core sources and the Win32/OpenGL3 backends are included. No demos or fonts
are copied. CMakeLists.txt and this provenance file are PitWall integration files.
